correctness.rationale: The exact inverse is lower bidiagonal with entries i/n and -(i-1)/n. Delete interblock entries: rank <=L-1 gives Kolmogorov distance <=(L-1)/n and W1 <=2(L-1)/n on [0,2]. Freezing each m-length block in spectral norm costs <=2m/n. The eigenvalues of (I-S_l)^*(I-S_l) are 4sin^2((2j-1)pi/(4l+2)); angle-cell coupling costs <=pi L/n and position coupling <=2m/n. Summing gives [2(L-1)+pi L+4m]/n, under 12/sqrt(n) for m=ceil(sqrt(n)) and n>=16; support diameter handles n<16. Conditioning U derives CDF and strictly positive interior density, yielding quantiles. The clipping map is M^2-Lipschitz on [0,2]. Independent finite singular-value and CDF-integral checks agreed at small/moderate n; these checks are diagnostics, not the all-n argument.
